properties.name: The design can say what it built and records no consumer for — and refuses to say "unused". The detector Anthony asked for after the content store was withdrawn "built, shipped, correct, and used zero times", written TEST-FIRST, which is what produced its central rule: run over reflow2's own design the raw signal named 100 of 110 built capabilities, so absence of a recorded consumer is reported only where recording one is the design's habit, and otherwise the RATIO is the finding.
